touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Kirton in Lindsey qualifies as a local detour through THE PRIORY and CHURCH OF ST ANDREW. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Kirton in Lindsey: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Kirton in Lindsey offers THE PRIORY, CHURCH OF ST ANDREW, TOWN HALL within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: THE PRIORY
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with THE PRIORY and CHURCH OF ST ANDREW, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
